articles.title: House Takes Up Russia Sanctions Bill Named for Lindsey Graham
articles.summary: The House voted Wednesday on a sweeping Russia sanctions bill named after the late Sen. Lindsey Graham. It targets Russian banks, oil tankers, and countries buying Russian oil with up to 100% tariffs. Supporters say it cuts off Putin's war money; critics fear it hurts allies and raises prices.

articles.title: Poll: Americans Increasingly Alarmed by AI's Environmental Footprint
articles.summary: A new poll finds 53% of Americans are very concerned about AI's environmental impact, up from 41% last year. Data centers that power AI use huge amounts of electricity and water, and many fear higher bills and local shortages. The debate is growing as more centers are built.

articles.title: EU Chief Backs Canada as First 'Associate Member'
articles.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen wants Canada to become the EU's first 'associate member.' Canadian PM Mark Carney seeks a 'unique alliance' as U.S. trade talks collapse. The plan could take years, and some EU members are skeptical.
